# AZ Restaurant Partners

> AZ Restaurant Partners sets up AI staff for independent restaurants: AI that takes phone orders into
> the POS (Clover) in English, Urdu, Hindi and Spanish, lets guests order and pay from the table, runs
> the restaurant's own online ordering and delivery, texts guests, grows reviews and Google/AI-search
> visibility, keeps ads profitable, and gives the owner one morning text, alerts and voice control.
> Proven first in the founder's own restaurant, Wok & Karahi in Spring, Texas, which runs with no
> server, no cashier and no phone person. Real numbers from October 2026: 98 of 99 dine-in orders were
> placed and paid by guests on their own phones; every call is answered by the AI host, and more than
> 1 in 4 calls arrive while the restaurant is closed; 94% of the restaurant's direct orders arrive with
> no staff member taking them (17% in August); 317 of 317 app orders were paid before cooking; Google
> reviews went from about 400 to 941 (4.5 stars) since the family took over.
> Founded by Abbas Zoeb, a former Google software engineer whose family owns Wok & Karahi.
>
> Serving Spring, The Woodlands, greater Houston and across Texas and the US.
>
> Pricing: priced by what the restaurant wants replaced, from just the phone to the whole front of
> house. Owners pick the jobs they want covered on the website and AZ replies the same day. No long
> contract. Five founding restaurants only; two are taken.

## What AZ does (offerings)
- Commission Rescue — move orders off the ~30% third-party delivery apps to first-party ordering.
- AI Phone Agent — answer every call 24/7, take orders into the POS, book tables, handle catering.
- Get found by AI & Google — AEO/SEO so AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) and search recommend the restaurant.
- More 5-star reviews — solicit happy guests, intercept unhappy ones before they post.
- Win back regulars — loyalty, consent-based SMS, and a guest list the owner owns.
- Catering & corporate lunches — a real off-premise channel at higher margins.
- End the tablet chaos — delivery apps consolidated into one POS/kitchen.
- See your numbers — one clear dashboard of sales, labor, and food cost across locations.
- Custom engineering — when no existing tool fits, AZ builds the software (or the non-software play) the restaurant uniquely needs.

## Where AZ works (Greater Houston, Texas)
Based in Spring, TX (77388). Independent restaurants across the Houston metro, with the
page for each area below. Houston lost 119 restaurants in the first half of 2026 — more
than any city in the US or Canada, Harris County leading every county
(source: https://restaurantdata.com/first-half-2026-restaurant-closure-report/).

- Deal: no vendor commissions, no equity, no percentage of sales. Founding partners pay
  nothing for three months, then $99/month to operate everything; custom work quoted per
  job and approved before it starts. Month-to-month, and the owner keeps everything built.
